title: Context
explain: A `context.Context` carries a deadline or cancellation signal through your call chain. Create one with `WithTimeout` or `WithCancel`, and always `defer cancel()` to release its resources. Functions that do slow work should take a context as their first parameter and stop when `ctx.Done()` fires.
exercise: Make a goroutine count upward every 10 milliseconds and stop it with `WithCancel` after 100 milliseconds.
tip: Don't store a context inside a struct. Pass it as the first argument of each function that needs it.
